assistantFetchExhaustiveness.listEndpoint: GET /assistant is a bare array of 28, no pagination wrapper. limit works; unknown query params are rejected with 400. createdAtGe/updatedAtGe are the only extra filters.
assistantFetchExhaustiveness.assistantScopedSweep: 22 candidate sub-paths probed; only /version and /versions exist. analytics, call, calls, metrics, log, logs, tool, tools, file, files, squad, test, eval, transcript, usage, cost, export, clone and duplicate all 404.
assistantFetchExhaustiveness.versionQueryParam: GET /assistant/{id}?version=vN IGNORES the parameter — v1, v2, v99 and 'bogus' all return the current record, byte-identical to a plain GET. It is not a way to retrieve historical config; /version and /versions are.
assistantFetchExhaustiveness.inlineFunctions: assistant.model.functions[] carries LEGACY inline function definitions with their own serverUrl, separate from model.toolIds and absent from /tool. 16 across 6 assistants, all non-NPC, all pointing at hook.eu2.make.com.
assistantFetchExhaustiveness.unfetchedReferences: artifactPlan.structuredOutputIds (5 distinct) and scorecardIds (1) reference resource types not yet retrieved.

artifactPlanReferences.structuredOutputs: GET /structured-output — 6 records, captured. 5 referenced, 1 orphan duplicate.
artifactPlanReferences.scorecards: RESOLVED at GET /observability/scorecard/{id}. The earlier 'dangling reference' conclusion was wrong - the path prefix was /observability/, which none of the 13 guessed paths used. The record exists, is org-owned and names both referencing assistants, but its metrics array is EMPTY.
artifactPlanReferences.reverseReferenceWarning: structuredOutput.assistantIds disagrees with the assistants on 3 of 6 records and is stale. The forward reference on the assistant is authoritative.

specVsLiveApi.conclusion: The published spec is a subset of what the API serves, and probing is a subset of what the spec documents. Neither alone is sufficient; this capture used both.

npcSplit.note: Vapi has no folder concept; the split is by name prefix and corroborated by squad membership and phone-number naming. Only the NPC set is in scope for migration — see ../npc-services/clone-plan.json.

redactions.rule: Exact match on the lowercased key against a fixed set, so maxTokens, promptCacheKey, isServerUrlSecretSet and the static-body-field 'key' are NOT caught while every credential key is. Backed by a value-based sweep over the whole tree as a second line of defence.
redactions.incident: An earlier anchored regex (^secret$ etc.) failed to match the header key 'x-vapi-webhook-secret' and the field 'serverUrlSecret'. Both were committed. See SECURITY-INCIDENT.md.

source.method: GET only — nothing in this org was modified to produce it
